notes.title: Delayed Release to Oct. 26th
notes.notes:
Tower of Madness will be delayed by one day, to October 26th, 2024. We appreciate the patience and understanding of the community as we put the final touches on this terrifying and immersive experience.

Tower of Madness invites players to confront their fears in a linear, narrative-driven horror adventure. With three possible endings based on player choices, five monsters designed to scare even the bravest of players, and an average playtime of 35 minutes, the game promises a gripping, unsettling journey into the unknown.

For the completionists, there are 17 Steam achievements to unlock, as well as 10 collectible notes scattered throughout the game that provide deeper insights into the mysterious and haunting story.

While the delay is brief, the extra time will ensure the best possible experience for all players. J6 Games is committed to delivering a polished, unforgettable horror experience, and we can't wait for players to uncover the secrets of the Tower of Madness. The game will have steam cloud saving, allowing players to pick up where they left off across devices.

notes.title: Price Announcement and Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who has tried out the Tower of Madness demo and shared feedback—your support means a lot! 

We've just rolled out a small update addressing some key issues that were reported before Next Fest, so feel free to check it out.

Also, we're excited to officially announce that the full game will launch at $4.99, with a 10% discount during the launch period. We can't wait for you to experience the full madness on October 25th!

Thanks again for all your support!
